name: sprawling plane of black
description: There's an otherworldly surface here, black as the depths of the earth.

name: strange open door
description: A wide open door swinging outward, into the darkness, beyond your reach.  The door and the frame look fresh, as if installed recently.

name: shallow ink pool
description: Shallow volume of pen ink, you briefly wonder if it's safe to drink.

name: deep ink
description: Deep volume of pen ink, swimming here in ill-advised.

name: plastic sand
description: An assortment of crushed pen caps, shredded paper and torn up cardboard, you could probably dig some of it up.
